# Algebra and tensor expressions

Types: `SymExpr`, `SparseFactor`, `FiniteHopfAlgebra`, `FiniteAlgebra`, `AlgebraElement`, `TaftAlgebra`, `Cyclotomic`, `RootSpec`, `KuperbergTensorExpression`

Specs: [module-structure.md](../../specs/module-structure.md), [algebra.md](../../specs/algebra.md), [hopf-invariants.md](../../specs/hopf-invariants.md)

## access

- `basis_element(algebra::FiniteAlgebra, index::Integer) -> AlgebraElement` — Return the indicated basis element of a finite algebra or the algebra underlying a Hopf algebra. [contract](basis_element.md)
- `basis_element(algebra::FiniteHopfAlgebra, index::Integer) -> AlgebraElement` — Return the indicated basis element of the algebra underlying a Hopf algebra. [contract](basis_element.md)
- `hopf_tensors(algebra::FiniteHopfAlgebra) -> Dict{String,SparseFactor}` — Return the structure-tensor dictionary used for contractions of a finite Hopf algebra. [contract](hopf_tensors.md)
- `legacy_hopf_tensors(algebra::FiniteHopfAlgebra) -> Dict{String,SparseFactor}` — Return Hopf-coordinate tensors for the legacy C250406 tensor-expression interface. [contract](legacy_hopf_tensors.md)

## condition

- `is_involutory(algebra::FiniteHopfAlgebra; …) -> Bool` — Numerically test involutivity of the stored antipode on the algebra's coordinate space. [contract](is_involutory.md)
- `is_unimodular(algebra::FiniteHopfAlgebra; …) -> Bool` — Numerically compare the lines represented by the stored left and right integral vectors. [contract](is_unimodular.md)
- `validate_tensor_expression(expression::AbstractString, outputs = Int[]; …) -> Vector{String}` — Return syntax, index and optional tensor-rank diagnostics for a coordinate tensor expression. [contract](validate_tensor_expression.md)
- `verify_hopf(algebra::FiniteHopfAlgebra; …) -> Dict{String,Bool}` — Return coordinate checks of the named Hopf identities for the supplied structural tensors. [contract](verify_hopf.md)

## convert

- `AlgebraElement(algebra::FiniteAlgebra, coefficients_or_index) -> AlgebraElement` — Return a coordinate element of the supplied finite-dimensional algebra. [contract](AlgebraElement.md)

- `heisenberg_double(algebra::FiniteHopfAlgebra) -> FiniteAlgebra` — Return the repository's Heisenberg-double product data on the dual/primal tensor-product space. [contract](heisenberg_double.md)
- `label_tensor(tensor::SparseFactor, labels) -> SparseFactor` — Return a labelled coordinate tensor with repeated labels restricted to their common diagonal. [contract](label_tensor.md)
- `sym(x::SymExpr) -> SymExpr` — Return a textual symbolic expression for the supplied value. [contract](sym.md)
- `KuperbergTensorExpression(hc::HeegaardCode, link::VirtualLink, factors::Vector{SparseFactor}, normalization::ComplexF64, …) -> KuperbergTensorExpression` — Store the finite tensor contraction associated with a Heegaard-code calculation. [contract](KuperbergTensorExpression.md)

- `invariant_expression(path::AbstractString, algebra::FiniteHopfAlgebra) -> KuperbergTensorExpression` — Read a Heegaard code and return its normalized finite Kuperberg coordinate network. [contract](../o-graph/invariant_expression.md)
- `invariant_expression(v::VirtualLink, H::FiniteHopfAlgebra) -> MSTTensorExpression` — Return the finite structural-tensor network associated with the o-graph data. [contract](../o-graph/invariant_expression.md)
